notes: The first volume of the combined Recreation and Park Commission, from its initial meeting of June 27, 1950 to December 27, 1951. Curated: field-house and building contracts of the 1947 recreation bond program, demolitions on new playground sites, playground and building names, and the 1951 dedication schedule. Dedication dates given in the schedule are the dates set; where the volume's index records the dedication, that is said.

coverage.remaining: This volume's routine items (payments, leases, concessions, tree work, golf and yacht harbor business) not curated; the Richmond Playground dedication (June 5, 1951) not placed, because the minutes do not say which of the two Richmond pages it is. Earlier and later volumes (Recreation Commission 1941-1950, Recreation and Park Commission 1952-1995) unread.
coverage.note: Meetings split with /mnt/project-files/sf-recreation-park/split.py, passages with cands.py; curated list F1950.py.
